info.name: Wingspan Payments 1099 Operations Bulk Operations API
Bulk Operations
Retrieve All Bulk Payable Batches

items.docs: Fetches a list of all the batches created for bulk payables, providing an overview of the bulk payment operations.

info.name: Initiate a New Bulk Payable Batch

items.docs: Creates a new batch for importing multiple payables at once, streamlining the bulk payment operations.

info.name: Retrieve Details of a Specific Bulk Payable Batch

items.docs: Fetches detailed information of a specific batch created for bulk payables, using the provided batch ID.

info.name: Modify a Specific Bulk Payable Batch

items.docs: Updates the information or items of a specific bulk payable batch, given its unique batch ID.

info.name: Remove a Specific Bulk Payable Batch

items.docs: Deletes a specific batch for bulk payables, using the provided batch ID, preventing any further operations on it.

info.name: Retrieve all items from a specific bulk payable batch

items.docs: Fetches and lists all individual payable items associated with a specified bulk payable batch. Useful for tracking and verifying batch details.

info.name: Add a new item to a specific bulk payable batch

items.docs: Allows for the creation and addition of a new individual payable item into an existing bulk payable batch. This enhances batch management and payable tracking.

info.name: Fetch the import summary for a specific bulk payable batch

items.docs: Provides an overview and summary of the import process for a given bulk payable batch, allowing for tracking of imported items, errors, and other relevant batch statistics.

info.name: Retrieve a Specific Item from a Bulk Payable Batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Fetches detailed information of a specific item within a bulk payable batch, using both the batch ID and the item ID.

info.name: Modify a Specific Item in a Bulk Payable Batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Updates the details or status of a specific item within a bulk payable batch, given both the batch ID and the item ID.

info.name: Retrieve All Bulk Invoice Batches

items.docs: Fetches a list of all the batches created for bulk invoices, providing an overview of the bulk invoicing operations.

info.name: Initiate a New Bulk Invoice Batch

items.docs: Creates a new batch for importing multiple invoices at once, streamlining the bulk invoicing operations.

info.name: Retrieve details of a specific bulk invoice batch

items.docs: Allows for the retrieval of a specified batch of bulk invoices by providing its unique batch identifier.

info.name: Modify the details of a specific bulk invoice batch

items.docs: Enables the user to update or modify the attributes of a given batch of bulk invoices by specifying its unique batch identifier.

info.name: Fetch all items from a specific bulk invoice batch

items.docs: Provides a list of all the items within a specified batch of bulk invoices, identified by its unique batch identifier.

info.name: Add a new item to a specific bulk invoice batch

items.docs: Allows users to append a new item to a given batch of bulk invoices by supplying its unique batch identifier and the details of the new item.

info.name: Retrieve a specific item from a bulk invoice batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Fetches detailed information about a specific item located within a designated bulk invoice batch. Useful for obtaining particular item data without browsing the entire batch.

info.name: Modify a specific item within a bulk invoice batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Allows for updates or edits to be made to a specific items details within an existing bulk invoice batch. Enhances the flexibility and management of invoice data.

info.name: Fetch all bulk collaborator batches

items.docs: Provides a list of all existing bulk collaborator batches, allowing users to view and manage batches that have been created for collaboration purposes.

info.name: Initiate a new bulk collaborator batch.

items.docs: Enables the creation of a new bulk collaborator batch, facilitating the bulk management and addition of collaborators for various projects or tasks.

info.name: Retrieve Details of a Specific Collaborator Batch

items.docs: Fetches detailed information of a specific bulk collaborator batch, using the provided batch ID.

info.name: Modify Details of a Bulk Collaborator Batch

items.docs: Allows for updating or altering the details and items within a specific bulk collaborator batch using the given batch ID.

info.name: Remove a Specific Collaborator Batch

items.docs: Deletes a specific bulk collaborator batch using its unique identifier. Once deleted, the batch cannot be recovered.

info.name: Retrieve all items from a specific collaborator batch

items.docs: Provides a comprehensive list of items present within a specified batch of collaborators, identifiable through its unique batch identifier.

info.name: Append a new item to a specific collaborator batch

items.docs: Allows for the addition of a new item to an existing batch of collaborators by providing the batchs unique identifier and item details.

info.name: Retrieve details of a specific item from a collaborator batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Enables fetching of detailed information about an individual item from a specified batch of collaborators using both the batch and item unique identifiers.

info.name: Modify the details of a specific item within a collaborator batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Provides the functionality to update or alter the attributes of an item present in a given collaborator batch using the unique identifiers for both the batch and the item.

info.name: Retrieve all bulk client batches

items.docs: Provides an overview of all existing bulk client batches, allowing users to quickly ascertain and manage batches created for the purpose of client onboarding or import.

info.name: Create a new bulk client batch

items.docs: Initiates the creation of a fresh bulk client batch, streamlining the process of adding multiple clients in one go.

info.name: Fetch Details of a Specific Item from a Client Batch

items.docs: Retrieves the detailed information of a specific item within the bulk client batch using both batch and item unique identifiers.

info.name: Modify Details of a Specific Item in a Client Batch

items.docs: Allows modification of the details of a specific item within the bulk client batch, using the provided item and batch identifiers.

info.name: Retrieve All Items from a Client Batch

items.docs: Fetches all items present in the specified bulk client batch, providing a comprehensive view of all client data in the batch.

info.name: Add a New Item to a Client Batch

items.docs: Inserts a new item into the specified bulk client batch, allowing for further expansion of client data within the batch.

info.name: Fetch Details of a Specific Item from a Client Batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Retrieves the detailed information of a specific item within the bulk client batch using both batch and item unique identifiers.

info.name: Modify Details of a Specific Item in a Client Batch

params.name: batchItemId
params.description: Unique identifier for an item in a batch

items.docs: Allows modification of the details of a specific item within the bulk client batch, using the provided item and batch identifiers.
